Fields.Name: Volumetric Fog Enabled
Fields.Description: Turns volumetric fog on for this level.

Fields.Name: Fog Shadow Sample Offset
Fields.Description: Added to the fog shadow sample count; the result is clamped to 1–32.

Fields.Name: Fog Local Light Distance Scale
Fields.Description: Multiplier on the distance over which local lights light the fog; 0 leaves local lights out of the fog.

Fields.Name: Fog Grid Size Multiplier
Fields.Description: Fog grid width and height = base size × Multiplier ÷ Divider, at least 16.

Fields.Name: Fog Grid Size Divider
Fields.Description: Divides the fog grid width and height (see Fog Grid Size Multiplier).

Fields.Name: Fog Depth Slice Multiplier
Fields.Description: Number of fog depth slices = base count × Multiplier ÷ Divider, at least 4.

Fields.Name: Fog Depth Slice Divider
Fields.Description: Divides the number of fog depth slices (see Fog Depth Slice Multiplier).

Fields.Name: Placed Fog Volumes Enabled
Fields.Description: Enables the fog volumes placed in maps, where the scene allows them.

Fields.Name: Fog Volume Upscale Type
Fields.Description: Upscale method of placed fog volumes. 2 selects the alternative method; 0 and 1 behave the same.

Fields.Name: Edge Correction Level
Fields.Description: Edge redraw level used with bilateral upscaling: 0 off, 1 half-resolution edges, 2 half- and full-resolution edges with reduced parameters, 3 half- and full-resolution edges.

Fields.Name: Extra Ray March Samples
Fields.Description: Only zero versus non-zero matters: any non-zero value turns on the extra ray-marching samples.

Fields.Name: Fog Volume Shadows Enabled
Fields.Description: Allows shadows and density shading in placed fog volumes.

Fields.Name: Force Fog Volume Shadows
Fields.Description: On: shadows are always cast into fog volumes when fog volume shadows are allowed, whatever the volume's own setting.

Fields.Name: Fog Volume Resolution
Fields.Description: Resolution step of the fog volume upscale, 0–2.
